whatThisPluginAdds.text: Theme Liquid Glass adds translucent layers, depth, refraction grids, and floating navigation to Capell page presentation. Capell and Layout Builder retain ownership of the page data.

surfaceOutcome.text: Use Preview Theme Liquid Glass on existing content before Apply Theme Liquid Glass, which changes the selected site's public design; reapply its previous theme to restore that selection. Shared Theme Studio settings saves can affect public pages. For fictional demo content, name a disposable target with --sites and review --url and --languages; unscoped setup refuses existing sites, scoped repeats preserve site configuration unless --force deliberately replaces its theme, enabled state, requested site translations and domains, while demo pages, widgets and demo layouts are rewritten on scoped repeats.

developers.text: Typed widget keys and a layout-native provider connect bespoke presentation to the shared Layout Builder container pipeline.

teams.text: Design teams can apply a consistent glass treatment across hero, grid, and navigation sections without relocating content into theme-specific storage.
